title: NSE hires 20 merchant bankers for its upcoming mega IPO
desc: NSE IPO: NSE has advanced its long-awaited IPO by finalising key intermediaries, including 20 merchant bankers, eight law firms, and advisory partners. These include major domestic and global investment banks such as Kotak Mahindra Capital Company, JM Financial, Axis Capital, ICICI Securities and SBI Capital Markets. The selected intermediaries will handle regulatory filings, due diligence, marketing, and execution.
